title: Harden A2A durable queue semantics
summary: Move A2A mailbox behavior from basic persistence toward a resumable queue contract with explicit task ownership, retry posture, compaction invariants, and operator-visible stuck-task state.
expectedFailureModes: A daemon restart replays a task that was already delivered but not compacted, causing duplicate agent work.
A result is posted after the sender context has expired and becomes permanently invisible to the intended peer.
Compaction removes unresolved tasks because task and result events are correlated by display identity instead of pubkey identity.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_restart_a2a -- --ignored live_
nextAction: Continue explicit requeue and lease-expiry repair under a2a-requeue-repair.
